storage_deviation_documented.description: One native-browser navigation to archived JAIS PDF automatically downloaded into T3 browser-managed storage outside worktree, contrary to requested storage constraint. The task-owned bytes were immediately moved into permitted private directory; no outside copy retained. Subsequent conference recovery used bounded in-browser byte fetch and direct private writes.
